items.title: Tamil movie ‘Koodu’ Explores Environmental Conservation and Community Responsibility at 57th IFFI
items.sum: Director Joyal Vijay presented the Tamil movie 'Koodu' at the 57th International Film Festival of India in Goa, accompanied by producers Rajesh Menon and Ganesh M, and actor V. Jayaprakash. Set in Vachathi, the movie tells the story of villagers who choose to live without electricity for 35 days to protect a sparrow's nest discovered inside a transformer. The director stated that the Earth does not belong to humans alone, emphasising the need for coexistence. Jayaprakash noted that learning about the real-life incident inspired him to minimize his personal use of tissue paper.
